criteria.reason: Response is entirely in Italian as requested.
Gives 60,000 and 0.8%, not the required ~40,000 main-language speakers/0.5%, and lacks adequate uncertainty.
Correctly calls it national, but wrongly cites 1848 and implies equal federal official use, omitting contact-only status.
Inconsistent with the required twin facts on speaker counts and constitutional status.

factual_errors: States 60,000 speakers and 0.8%, not ~40,000 main-language speakers/0.5%.
Says the Constitution was adopted in 1848; the current constitution dates from 1999.
Implies Romansh has equal official use in all federal administrative, judicial, and parliamentary contexts.
summary: The response is in Italian but gives inaccurate speaker figures and an overbroad, partly false constitutional description.
